rationale: NVCR gapped down ~11% on no news catalyst, recovered significantly from the $11.85 low, and is now sitting at 90.7% of today's range near the session high of $13.63 — a poor risk/reward entry point for a long. A short at this level risks continuation of the intraday recovery toward the prior close, while a long is chasing a move that has already largely played out with price compressed against resistance at the day's high. With no news context to explain the gap and price action showing indecision in the last five 1-minute candles, the edge is insufficient to justify a new position.
